message: Vector Rebel 3.2.68: recover a fully answered SCBA form after a premature review pause, and wait for stable native response verification before submitting.
releaseNotes: Observed on live Voyager: AP-60 at SCBA check 5/7, official form 113271 instance 9592720, all 11 question rows visibly completed and Passed, unique native Submit Inspection still enabled; Rebel had latched form_review_required. This release validates the 11 exact native completed question containers instead of a flattened page-text snapshot, allows 12 seconds for final React hydration before any review-only fallback, and safely resumes an older paused queue ONLY when the same exact native inspection form instance still has all 11 reviewed responses, physical approval and no submission attempt. It does not re-click any answers, does not start another native inspection, and does not retry an uncertain prior Submit.
